shelters.name: Deane Bozeman Learning Center (Primary Special Needs Shelter)
shelters.group_about: These shelters are designated for individuals with medical, access, or functional needs who cannot safely evacuate to a general population shelter. Pre-registration through the Florida Special Needs Registry is required.

shelters.name: Deer Point Elementary School
shelters.group_about: These shelters are intended for the general public during evacuations and are selected for their safety standards, capacity, and geographic distribution.

shelters.group_about: These shelters are intended for the general public during evacuations and are selected for their safety standards, capacity, and geographic distribution.

shelters.name: Tommy Smith Elementary School

shelters.group_about: These shelters are intended for the general public during evacuations and are selected for their safety standards, capacity, and geographic distribution.

shelters.name: Rutherford High School
shelters.group_about: These shelters are intended for the general public during evacuations and are selected for their safety standards, capacity, and geographic distribution.

shelters.name: Tom P. Haney Technical College (Haney Technical Center)
shelters.group_about: This facility is designated to support large-scale shelter operations and may serve as a technical support site during mass care incidents.

shelters.name: Bay County Fairgrounds
shelters.group_about: These shelters are used during the post-impact phase to support residents who are displaced and unable to return home immediately following a disaster.

shelters.name: A.D. Harris Learning Village
shelters.group_name: Alternate Risk and Extreme Weather Shelter
shelters.group_about: This location is activated on an as-needed basis to support overflow during major emergencies or to provide warming/cooling shelter during extreme temperatures.
